change_summary: Define Garden dev-branch engineering contributions with independently verified pull-request evidence and task association.

task_examples.title: Correct the local PostgreSQL port-conflict instructions
task_examples.content: At dev c61609fc4170ea76238b1fb53b1c00177448dad5, Garden README still suggests changing only DATABASE_URL if host port 55432 is occupied. Align it with onboarding: change the compose.dev.yaml host mapping and DATABASE_URL together, keep container port 5432 distinct, and link the detailed instructions. Do not change runtime configuration or delete data volumes. Start from and target dev.

task_examples.title: Document the Garden Workstream contribution handoff
task_examples.content: Add a concise contributor page for the approved Workstream project: claim, task trailer before final review, required GitHub checks and merge, proof.json ZIP and PRE/POST feedback. Link it from CONTRIBUTING without replacing the ordinary GitHub contribution path. Use explicit placeholders and no credentials. Start from and target dev.
